title: TIME AND US
author: Priyalakshmi Gogoi
text:
Where did those days go?
TIME - flew like a river
In it we went with the flow
Reflecting our moments like a mirror.

Days of sunshine and laughter
Blessed us with all fruits
Did not stay the same forever,
Calmness and patience found its routes.

Life came with all its twists and turns
Closed ones` journey to the other end
Gave us blows and burns
With it wisdom embraced us at every bend.

We pray to the Almighty
To keep us safe and sound
He is the One so mighty,
In Him the safest abode we found.

He is our guiding light
Protecting us in every form
He is there to make our lives bright
Helping us go through every storm.
